<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyphs(L):
    S = [tuple(''.join(L[r][15+7*i:20+7*i]) for r in range(41,46)) for i in range(5)]
    P = [tuple(''.join(L[r][15+7*i:20+7*i]) for r in range(52,57)) for i in range(5)]
    return S,P
L0 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
S0,P0 = glyphs(L0)
action(['LEFT'])
L1 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
S1,P1 = glyphs(L1)
print('after LEFT: S changed:', [i for i in range(5) if S0[i]!=S1[i]], 'P changed:', [i for i in range(5) if P0[i]!=P1[i]])
# white blocks position
import re
for name,L in [('L0',L0),('L1',L1)]:
    blocks=[(r,c) for r in range(40,64) for c in range(64) if L[r][c]=='W' or L[r][c]=='w']
    rows=sorted(set(r for r,c in blocks))
    print(name,'white rows:',rows, 'cols:', sorted(set(c for r,c in blocks)))
action(['UP'])
L2 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
S2,P2 = glyphs(L2)
print('after UP: S changed:', [i for i in range(5) if S1[i]!=S2[i]], 'P changed:', [i for i in range(5) if P1[i]!=P2[i]])
print('P0 now:', P2[0])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
